No Dolbly] > Master Cassettes [Sony UCX90]; tapes was dubbed on a Aiwa CX-NA555; Tape Transfer: Sharp RT100 Deck > Sony PCM-M10 > Scandisc Ultra MicroSD 8gb [class 10] on 12/27/2016; Settings: Sharp RT100 Deck: Dolby NR - OFF & CrO2 - OFF; Settings: Sony PCM-M10 manual record level at 6; Recording Mode: LPCM [wav] 96.00kHz/24bit; Mastering & Editing: 96.00kHz/24bit wav > AA3 was used for +/- db gains, removing some cable connection pops.
